failedCandidates.notes: Six failed lanes: two sandbox setup failures, one obsolete embedded shared-proxy fixture and composed provider/UI fixture or assertion mismatches. Targeted parity, controller and browser regressions pass locally; real sandbox and cluster outcomes require final-head CI.

All22 source lanes, First Agent Smoke and CodeQL passed. Native AMD64 sandbox probe hit Ubuntu24 user-namespace restrictions. Native ARM64 passed142/144 cases but two nested Docker sandbox cases lacked the reviewed CI AppArmor profile. Repair only native workflow setup and its documentation; qualify the resulting SHA.

Source CI and CodeQL passed. Native AMD64 local image import failed because distro Skopeo1.4.1 used Docker API1.22 while the daemon requires1.24+. Use a temporary Docker archive and the native Docker CLI; keep all digest/config/architecture checks and qualify the resulting SHA.

Static checks found a stale generated Agent operation count. The cluster embedded-channel lifecycle still selected the retired shared proxy. Regenerate the API reference and use the real revision-owned proxy with exact Secret delivery, revision cutover and withdrawal assertions. Qualify the repaired final SHA.

The real embedded Pod passed exact Secret delivery. The new revision-cutover assertion incorrectly required the Gateway-only agent-revision-id annotation on the outbound proxy. Check the common Pod template revision label instead; retain exact revision ownership and full withdrawal checks.

Embedded deployment, replacement and stale-retirement fencing passed. Teams disablement incorrectly treated the committed active pointer as completed Kubernetes activation. Await real callback withdrawal and the exact ready replacement Pod, and verify the disabled credential is absent inside that Pod.

The shared serving assertion also read the old Deployment immediately after the active-pointer commit. Observe the exact ready revision Pod and callback before checking projection and fencing at every cutover, including reenablement. Keep all real resource and credential assertions.

Database and Kubernetes lifecycle lanes passed. Three source lanes found stale single-provider UI/conformance expectations and missing WebKit preparation. The earlier native AMD64 run42074279022 passed246/247 cases; its Teams media fixture used host-only certificate permissions and obsolete shared-proxy options. Keep the runtime unprivileged, permit read-only synthetic certificate access and select exact Graph/SharePoint destinations with the generic proxy. The repaired targeted native media case passes locally; qualify the resulting final SHA on both architectures.
